Introduction

Woo Won-jae, popularly known as Woo, is a South Korean rapper recognized for his moody, dark musical style, characterized by raw lyrics drawn from real-life experiences. He first gained recognition as a contestant on Show Me the Money 6, where he finished third. He released the single “We Are” featuring Gray and Loco on September 4, 2017. The song was initially meant to be his finale song on SMTM6. The track was a commercial success, topping multiple Korean charts.

On October 31, 2017, it was announced that Woo has signed with AOMG. Following the signing, he released the single album “Anxiety” in November. The same month, he released his first EP “af”. Woo later released his first studio album “Black Out” on August 18, 2020.

After his contract with AOMG expired, Woo, alongside Gray and Code Kunst co-founded the label Duover in 2024.
